name: Process Run Photo
description: One piece of photo evidence, held flat on the run and tied to a step by step_code. Photos are camera-only — the app offers no gallery picker, because yesterday's photo must not be able to pass today's check. Capture coordinates are stored here as well as burnt into the image itself.

fields.label: Received At (Server)
fields.description: Compared with captured_at to spot photos uploaded long after capture.

fields.label: Location Source
fields.description: Unavailable is a valid recorded outcome — indoor plant GPS often is. The shutter never waits on a fix.

fields.label: Geofence
fields.description: Evaluated server-side. Recorded and reported, never blocking.

fields.label: Stamped
fields.description: Date-time, coordinates and the capturing user were burnt into the image.

fields.label: EXIF Written
fields.description: Burn-in survives screenshots; EXIF survives resizing. We record both.
